BJP Women MPs Demand Congress MP's Suspension Over JNU Row

Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) women Members of Parliament met with President Droupadi Murmu to demand the suspension of Congress MP Bimol Akoijam from the Lok Sabha. The demand is reportedly linked to a Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) sexual assault controversy.
